name: bhdc_100m
note: The ~100M fused BHDCMoralLM. Needs MPS (Apple M-series) or a GPU; on 4 CPU cores this is impractical to train to convergence. pick_device() auto-selects cuda>mps>cpu.

preregistration.prediction: At ~100M params on byte-level text, capability (val bits-per-byte) drops well below the 8.0 random baseline while the conscience heads develop a positive harm/care/sycophancy separation on the held-out moral val set, and the forward coupling shows lower mean gain on harmful fields than benign ones (it damps harmful modes). None of this certifies alignment; the audit remains the boundary.
preregistration.kill_condition: KILL/([TESTED-NEGATIVE]) if capability does not fall below baseline (backbone not learning), OR the conscience shows no harm/care separation on val after training (anchor signal not learnable at this scale), OR enabling the coupling destroys benign capability beyond tolerance.
